name: Sage Group plc
why_them: Sage is a large FTSE-listed software company. Its Sage Foundation says it has raised about $5M globally over 10 years, and in 2024–25 it narrowed its focus to underserved small businesses and to communities and young people, including next-gen digital skills such as AI (https://www.sage.com/en-gb/company/digital-newsroom/2025/07/02/sage-foundation-celebrates-10-years-of-impact-5-million-raised-and-1-3-million-hours-volunteered/; same content via https://www.cpapracticeadvisor.com/2025/07/22/sage-foundation-celebrates-10-years-of-impact-5-million-raised-and-1-3-million-hours-volunteered/165349/). Youth digital skills is a good fit, but the coverage did not mention STEM specifically. I found no open grant round or application route. Sage's foundation pages mention partnerships such as Teens in AI and FIRST LEGO League, and the only dated grant fund I found (Manchester Community Central, $5k–$35k) closed in 2017, so it counts as weak evidence. The Sage pages returned 403 errors, so I relied on a secondary source (CPA Practice Advisor) for the press release text.
to_verify: Confirm whether the Sage Foundation has an open grant or application route for UK youth/STEM charities
Check the Sage Group annual report 2025 for community investment spend and sustainability section
Verify Teens in AI and FIRST LEGO League partnerships are current, and whether they are with the Nonprofit's competitors
Find a named contact on the Sage Foundation team
Confirm Sage has no defence, gambling or tobacco exposure (none seen)
